turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: I noticed a painless mass in my right breast about three weeks ago, and it hasn’t changed in size. I’m currently 17 weeks pregnant, but I don’t have any other symptoms like fever, nipple discharge, or skin changes.

Patient: I haven’t been told it’s fibroadenoma specifically—my main concern is the painless right-breast mass that I noticed about three weeks ago and it hasn’t changed. I don’t have any fever, nipple discharge, or skin changes.
